Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) , has released the Mains Online Form Notice for the recruitment of Auditor Posts. This recruitment is for 102 positions. The BPSC Mains application form has started on 29 October 2026, and candidates can apply until 16 November 2026. The minimum age is 21 Years & the maximum age is 37 – 42 years as on 01 August 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for the BPSC Auditor Mains Online Form 2026 provided below. (Advt. No. 09/2026)

Bihar BPSC Auditor Examination 2026 : Short Details
Online Apply Start Date : 05 February 2026
Online Apply Last Date : 26 February 2026
Last Date For Fee Payment : 26 February 2026
Mains Form Date : 29 October – 16 November 2026
Candidates are advised to confirm from the Bihar BPSC official website.
Payment Mode (Online): You can make the payment using the following methods: Debit Card Credit Card Internet Banking IMPS Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
Maximum Age : 40 Years (Female UR, BC/ EBC-Male & Female)
Maximum Age : 42 Years (SC/ ST-Male & Female)
Bihar BPSC provides age relaxation for the Auditor position as per their regulations.
Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree with Commerce, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics as a subject , or possess a professional qualification such as CA, CS, or MBA in Finance to be eligible for this post.
